Now getting it into the Marimo room: checking which bots are already members so one can invite it.㊥ (@fumarimo provisioned) @fumarimo now exists on matrix.paragogy.net as an ordinary, non-admin account. It has an access token and has joined the Marimo/象 demo room, `!_qvu9Pec8-hw1-nsN18SA8uIChKlJPmS4f4ji3zajRw`, which it could join without an invite.

㊢ (where the credentials are)
- **On lucy:** `~/.config/futon3c/matrix/fumarimo.{password,token}`, mode 600, next to the bridge bots' files.
- **On Zone:** a copy of the token only, at `~/.config/futon3c/matrix/fumarimo.token`. The directory is mode 700 and the file is mode 600. I made this copy because Marimo runs on Zone. With this token, a whoami call from Zone returns `@fumarimo:matrix.paragogy.net`.
- **Never printed:** neither the password nor the token was printed. The token was piped over SSH straight into the file.

㊟ (wiring it up) For your Codex: `fumarimo_agent.py` reads its token through the bridge's `MatrixBot`. Point it at Zone with these settings:
- `MATRIX_TOKEN_DIR=~/.config/futon3c/matrix`
- `MATRIX_HOMESERVER_URL=https://matrix.paragogy.net`
- the room above in `MATRIX_ROOMS`

The nick must be `fumarimo`, because the bridge checks the nick against the token's account. `_send` refuses to post to any room that isn't in its channel list, so the room has to be in `MATRIX_ROOMS`.

㊢ (also noticed) Your Codex has already committed both Element items to `futon/main`: `121a885c1b` (one poller per room) and `46f32bed21` (show 小象 drafts). I haven't reviewed them yet. Ask if you'd like me to.

previous_reply_acts.text:
(how @fucodex was registered) I registered @fucodex on 14 September from a shell on lucy, which hosts your own homeserver. No separate administrator account was needed:
1. **Create the account.** Over `ssh lucy-joe`, I ran Synapse's own registration tool inside its container:
   `docker exec matrix-synapse register_new_matrix_user -c /data/homeserver.yaml -u fucodex -p <random password> --no-admin http://localhost:8008`
   The tool signs the request with the `registration_shared_secret` in `homeserver.yaml`, so being able to get into the container is all the authority it needs.
2. **Get the token.** A password login (`POST /_matrix/client/v3/login`) to `127.0.0.1:8008` on lucy returned the access token.
3. **Store the credentials.** The password and token went into `~/.config/futon3c/matrix/fucodex.{password,token}` (mode 600 in a 700 directory). Neither was ever printed.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-17
previous_reply_acts.text: (the line you quoted) "A homeserver administrator must provision the account" is true in general Matrix terms. Here, though, anyone who can SSH to `lucy-joe` is effectively that administrator. Your Codex in the fork can do it the same way if it has that SSH access. Otherwise I can do it from here.
